endpoints: POST https://dmerch.iheartjane.com/v2/multi and /v2/smartpage as in backend/providers/jane.py
data_loading.notes: SDK key is public and read from iheartjane.com/stores/<id>; dmerch accepted a plain honest-UA client.

why_it_fails: It mostly works but at lower quality and with a leak. (1) The saved bradford endpoint is read by the generic structured/DOM path (rendered Rise page, 997 variants, no advertised total) so it reaches only grade B and is hidden from /deals unless include_unverified. At HEAD, adapters.resolve_menu runs jane_hosted_store on any popped URL, which would store provider jane with provider_store_id 7270 and a reconciled facet total (grade A); the DB still shows generic, cause not established (rows were written under older fingerprint 3af5418b55; I did not read storage upsert code). (2) Wrong-branch leakage: the Rise listing/branch pages cross-link the same-city sibling 'Bloom Wellness Normal Northbrook' (the former Revolution Dispensary - Normal, a different registry store) and locators/site_discovery accepted its 7274 menu URLs as candidates for this store (same city name). The generic path cannot prove the branch so these sit as partial endpoints; the native Jane reader would reject them (0.38 mi > MAX_MILES 0.35 and hosted_store identity None).
fix_idea: Run this store through the native Jane path: resolve from Rise's directory (menuDetails ids 7270/7450) and let jane.py prove the branch by pin. Drop or supersede the 3 northbrook endpoints on this store and attach 7274/7449 to Revolution Dispensary - Normal (7f48ac07b32cfe68397a4334) instead. Add a guard so a same-city sibling slug (different street) is an identity_conflict, not a candidate (compare the Rise API address street, not just city). Also skip ?refinementList facet URLs at crawl time (menu_document_scope already marks them filtered).
